public_nonduplicate_tasks.evidence: 1,500 released VQA questions with distinct image-geometry tuples; 899 released source images.

relevant_foundation_model.evidence: Intern-S1 is a named multimodal scientific foundation model with reported materials relevance; benchmark-specific MATCHA benefit is not established.

harbor.evidence: All 100 frozen tasks were scheduled through Harbor with real images; pilot transport recordings matched staged images byte-for-byte.

deepseek_binary_accuracy.evidence: Primary n100 is 70/100 at the excluded strict upper boundary with simultaneous intervals crossing70%. Of frozen additional200, 161 completed (111 successes) before the precommitted stop rule; 39 unrun tasks are not replaced, and no incomplete-expansion point estimate is used.

verifier_false_positive.evidence: Blind GPT-5.1/Claude corroboration supports 61/300 sampled-task FPs. Two-look Wilson97.5% CI [15.63%,26.01%] and paper-group bootstrap97.5% CI [15.23%,25.74%] both have lower bounds strictly above15%.

verifier_false_negative.evidence: Exact specific-option cross-provider agreement on 50/300. Two-look Wilson97.5% CI [12.40%,22.03%] and paper-group bootstrap [11.96%,21.64%] cross15%.

audit_independence: Both providers reviewed actual images blind to gold, each other, verifier outcomes and DeepSeek answers. GPT audited all300; Claude audited all96 GPT flags. Thirty-one primary flags were contradicted by Claude, eleven agreed gold was invalid but disagreed on the alternate, and four were unresolved; all count conservatively.
stop_reason: Verifier FP lower bounds are strictly above15% under both precommitted two-look Wilson and paper-group cluster inference; stop remaining costly accuracy tasks.
